entries.title: Psalms 96:1
segments:
PSALM XCVI. 
 
  This psalm is a part of that which was delivered to Asaph and his   brethren,

,   on occasion of bringing up the ark to the city of David.   Here is a call to praise God, as a great and glorious God, ver. 1-9.   To rejoice in his judging all the world, ver. 10-13. 
 
  V. 1. O sing-Upon this new and great occasion, not the removal of the ark, but the coming of the Messiah.

entries.title: Psalms 96:4
segments: V. 4. Gods-The gods of the nations, as the next verse expounds it.

entries.title: Psalms 96:9
segments: V. 9. Beauty-Cloathed with all the gifts and graces, which are necessary in God's worship.

entries.title: Psalms 96:10
segments: V. 10. Reigneth-God hath now set up his kingdom in the world. Established-The nations of the world shall by the means of it enjoy an established and lasting peace.

entries.title: Psalms 96:13
segments: V. 13. Before-At the presence and approach of their Lord and Maker. Cometh-To set up his throne among all the nations of the earth.
